title: Build a mini ORM in Python — 4 turns
description: Four-turn mini ORM: turn 1 model definition, turn 2 create/save, turn 3 query/filter, turn 4 relationships and tests.

files.tests/test_orm.py:
import pytest
from orm.fields import IntField, StrField
from orm.model import Model


class User(Model):
    id = IntField(primary_key=True)
    name = StrField()
    age = IntField()


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clear_table():
    User._table.clear()
    User._next_id = 1
    yield


def test_create_and_save():
    u = User.create(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert u._id_val is not None
    assert u._name == "Alice"
    assert u._age == 30


def test_auto_increment_id():
    u1 = User.create(name="A", age=1)
    u2 = User.create(name="B", age=2)
    assert u2._id_val > u1._id_val


def test_all_returns_saved():
    User.create(name="A", age=1)
    User.create(name="B", age=2)
    all_users = User.all()
    assert len(all_users) == 2


def test_filter_by_field():
    User.create(name="Alice", age=30)
    User.create(name="Bob", age=25)
    User.create(name="Alice", age=22)
    results = User.filter(name="Alice")
    assert len(results) == 2
    assert all(u._name == "Alice" for u in results)


def test_get_returns_first():
    User.create(name="Charlie", age=40)
    u = User.get(name="Charlie")
    assert u is not None
    assert u._name == "Charlie"


def test_get_returns_none_if_missing():
    assert User.get(name="Nobody") is None


def test_field_type_coercion():
    u = User.create(name="Dave", age="35")  # age as string
    assert u._age == 35
    assert isinstance(u._age, int)

task_spec.prompt: Implement `save(self)` and `create(cls, **kwargs)` in `orm/model.py`. save: if `self._id_val` is None, assign the next ID from `cls._next_id` (then increment it) and append self to `cls._table`; return self. create: instantiate the class with kwargs and call save(). Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q`.
